label: A · 纸感书房
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity Chinese Windows desktop application UI concept screenshot for Git Onboarding, wide landscape 1536x1024. Full bleed app screenshot, no device or perspective, opaque background. This is a genuine usable Git learning workspace, not marketing, not dashboard analytics. Hold this composition exactly: thin top navigation brand left, 学习路径 and 练习工作台, font size control right; narrow left lesson sidebar about 190px; remaining workspace top lesson heading and short mission, middle two equal large panels README editor left and full Bash terminal right, bottom wide completion report with next lesson button. Content and same layout maintained for comparing visual styles.
Exact text: sidebar 我的练习, 01 你的第一次提交, 02 和队友一起开发, 03 从容地修正错误. Heading 你的第一次提交. Mission 在 README.md 中写下学习记录，然后创建一次提交。 Small mode 独立挑战.
Editor tab README.md and visible 保存 control. Editor content with line numbers: # Git 学习手册, blank line, 学习从这里开始。, blank line, 今天完成了第一次提交。.
Terminal title 终端 · Bash; no terminal line numbers; contents:
$ git add README.md
$ git commit -m "记录学习成果"
[main 11a701f] 记录学习成果
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)
$ git status
On branch main
nothing to commit, working tree clean
$
Completion report heading 本关已完成, checks README 修改已提交 and 工作区与暂存区干净, commit evidence main · 11a701f, secondary 再次检查 and prominent 下一关：协作与冲突. Show meaningful icons and actual functional controls only. No decorative charts, no fake metrics, no stock photos, no floating gimmicks. Readable Chinese body approximating16px at logical viewport, helper text14px, title32px, crisp medium contrast. Avoid tiny washed-out text. Terminal and editor occupy majority of main viewport.
ART DIRECTION A — WARM EDITORIAL STUDY. A sophisticated editorial typesetting aesthetic with notably distinct Chinese Songti/serif lesson headline, serif large lesson numerals, restrained humanist Chinese sans serif for functional body and navigation, excellent calligraphic stroke contrast in title only. Palette warm ivory #F4F0E7 canvas, parchment #FFFDF7 panels, ink #27251F text, muted terracotta #B74F34 primary buttons and selected indicators, muted olive successful checks. Warm charcoal-brown terminal #292722. Sidebar the same ivory background separated by a single thin ink rule, selected lesson a subtle terracotta left rule, no colored rounded tile. Square corners with only 3px radius, understated hairline borders, editorial baseline alignment, generous whitespace, no shadows, no gradients. Top tiny terracotta geometric git logo. Thin orderly table-like completion area on cream with a terracotta rectangular CTA. Do NOT use navy blue, teal, cobalt, purple, all-caps SaaS badges, generic blue-white rounded cards. Overall emotion composed, adult, thoughtful, quiet reading room. Fonts and shapes must visually embody that style, not simply recolor a standard SaaS template.
